# Resource: tfe_project_settings

Manages project settings.

Primarily, this resource allows setting default execution mode and agent pool for all workspaces within a project. When not specified, the organization defaults will be used.

-> **Note:** Requires Terraform CLI version 1.0 and later.

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.organization.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.project.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.agentPool.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.organizationDefaultSettings.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.projectSettings.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        Organization tfeOrganizationTest = new Organization(this, "test", new OrganizationConfig()
                .email("admin@company.com")
                .name("my-org-name")
                );
        Project tfeProjectMyProject = new Project(this, "my_project", new ProjectConfig()
                .name("my-project")
                .organization(Token.asString(tfeOrganizationTest.getName()))
                );
        AgentPool tfeAgentPoolMyAgents = new AgentPool(this, "my_agents", new AgentPoolConfig()
                .name("my-agent-pool")
                .organization(Token.asString(tfeOrganizationTest.getName()))
                );
        new OrganizationDefaultSettings(this, "org_default", new OrganizationDefaultSettingsConfig()
                .defaultAgentPoolId(Token.asString(tfeAgentPoolMyAgents.getId()))
                .defaultExecutionMode("agent")
                .organization(Token.asString(tfeOrganizationTest.getName()))
                );
        new ProjectSettings(this, "my_project_settings", new ProjectSettingsConfig()
                .defaultAgentPoolId(Token.asString(tfeAgentPoolMyAgents.getId()))
                .defaultExecutionMode("agent")
                .projectId(Token.asString(tfeProjectMyProject.getId()))
                );
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `projectId` (String) The ID of the project to manage settings for.

### Optional

- `defaultAgentPoolId` (String) The ID of an agent pool to assign to the project. Requires `defaultExecutionMode` to be set to `agent`. This value must not be provided if `defaultExecutionMode` is set to any other value.
- `defaultExecutionMode` (String) Which [execution mode](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/settings#execution-mode) to use as the default for all workspaces in the project. Valid values are `remote`, `local` or `agent`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service-generated identifier for the resource.
- `overwrites` (Attributes) Can be used to check whether a setting is currently inheriting its value from the organization or is being overwritten. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--overwrites))

<a id="nestedatt--overwrites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `overwrites`

Read-Only:

- `defaultAgentPoolId` (Boolean) Set to `true` if the default agent pool of the project is being determined by the setting on the project itself. It will be `false` if the agent pool is inherited from another resource (e.g. the organization's default agent pool).
- `defaultExecutionMode` (Boolean) Set to `true` if the default execution mode of the project is being determined by the setting on the project itself. It will be `false` if the execution mode is inherited from another resource (e.g. the organization's default execution mode).




## Import

Resource tfe_project_settings can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <PROJECT ID>
terraform import tfe_project_settings.my_project_settings prj-F1NpdVBuCF3xc5R
```
